desc: Analyze the functional graph structure and prove that every directed cycle forms a single equality component.
Derive a DP for counting assignments satisfying inequalities after SCC contraction, with complexity suitable for \(N,M\le 2025\).
Implement cycle contraction and rooted-forest DP in Python with modular arithmetic and stdin/stdout handling.
Verify correctness for self-loops, nontrivial cycles, disconnected functional-graph components, and the sample cases.
